title: Draft UK-US extradition treaty written in American English

tellings.quote: and it was written a British extradition treaty with America was written in American English

plain: In 2003, a draft of the treaty that sets the rules for Britain sending suspects to the United States for trial was, according to Gary McKinnon, written in American English. McKinnon, a British hacker who says he found signs of a secret space program in NASA computers and then fought being sent to the US, says his lawyers noticed this, along with documents from the General Accounting Office, the US Congress's auditing agency. He tells it to suggest that the American side wrote a treaty that was meant to be British.
